presentation.title: Analytics data pipeline — Dimentionalizer
presentation.headline: Analytics data pipeline.
presentation.description: Operational events and batch extracts flow through ingestion, raw storage, transformation, and a warehouse to dashboards. A logical reference for analytical workloads.

objects.name: Operational application
objects.description: Produces business events as application activity occurs.

objects.name: Operational database
objects.description: Holds transactional data used by periodic extracts.

objects.name: Event collector
objects.description: Validates incoming events and attaches ingestion metadata.

objects.name: Durable event stream
objects.description: A replayable event log. Kept as Container because a stream is not the same semantic type as a work queue.

objects.name: Landing writer
objects.description: Consumes events and writes partitioned files into raw object storage.

objects.name: Batch extractor
objects.description: Reads incremental snapshots from the operational database.

objects.name: Raw data storage
objects.description: Keeps untransformed input for replay and investigation.

objects.name: Pipeline orchestrator
objects.description: Schedules extracts and transformation stages and tracks their dependencies.

objects.name: Transform workers
objects.description: Validate, deduplicate, and transform raw records into analytical models.

objects.name: Rejected records
objects.description: Retains invalid records and validation context for investigation.

objects.name: Analytical warehouse
objects.description: Stores curated tables optimized for analytical queries.

objects.name: Analytics API
objects.description: Applies access rules and exposes aggregate results to dashboards.

objects.name: Query result cache
objects.description: Caches selected aggregates for a bounded period.

objects.name: BI dashboards
objects.description: Displays business metrics and analytical views to authorized users.
